title.narrative: Construction of Qukes-Qafe Plloce (Choocus-Chalf Ploch) Section of Tirana-Korca Road Corridor Project

description.narrative: The objective of the project is to facilitate the socio-economic development by constructing a new, most direct, and shortest road link between Qukës and Qafë Plloçë to provide improved access, higher road safety, reduced congestion and increased overall efficiency of road transport system.
